title: VX/VXA as a beginner can someone please help me with this.

posts.author: Bridgeguy2137
posts.body: have no clue what it means

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
It basically means that the engine/script was given a reference to a data object that does not exist.
most common cause is trying to continue a (now incompatible) savefile after adding or removing an entire script. You should always start new playtestgames after adding scripts.
second most common cause is a wrong configuration in a script - not every script can work without detailed configuration for your specific game, and the more complex a script is the higher the chance it will not work out-of-the-box.
as a new user I strongly suggest working through my starting point tutorial in my signature, possibly followed by the "how to use a script" after that.
